name: Bundled synthetic intake questions
description: What the intake page asks a business requester, per request type of the default policy. Field types, value bands and request types come from the request contract and the policy. Illustrative wording for synthetic requests; not legal advice.

title.label: Short title
title.hint: One line, for example: Supply agreement with Example Robotics GmbH (synthetic).

type.label: What do you need help with?
type.hint: Choose the closest match; legal can change it. A few questions for the type you choose appear after the questions about the request.
type.error: Choose what you need help with

counterparty.label: Other party
counterparty.hint: The company or person on the other side, if there is one.

value_band.label: Value of the contract or claim
value_band.hint: In euros, without VAT. If it runs for more than a year or has no end date, use the highest yearly value and give the total and how long it runs in “What do you need from legal?”. For a claim, use the amount claimed. Not sure? Choose the higher band it could be in and say why in “What do you need from legal?”.
value_band.error: Choose the value of the contract or claim

options.50k-250k: EUR 50,000 or more but under EUR 250,000

personal_data.label: Does it involve personal data?
personal_data.hint: Information about a person, such as names, email addresses or employee records. This includes data that can be linked to a person, such as customer or user IDs, IP addresses, cookie IDs or location data, even if names have been removed or replaced with codes. Not sure? Choose Yes and say why in “What do you need from legal?”.
personal_data.error: Choose whether it involves personal data

non_eea_transfer.label: Does it involve any data sent to or accessed from outside the EEA?
non_eea_transfer.hint: The EEA is the EU plus Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway, not the UK or Switzerland. Choose Yes if any organisation or server outside the EEA, including a company in our group, holds, gets or sees any of the data, or will, even just for support. Not sure? Choose Yes and say why in “What do you need from legal?”.
non_eea_transfer.error: Choose whether any data is sent to or accessed from outside the EEA

uncapped_liability.label: Is there unlimited liability on our side?
uncapped_liability.hint: Choose Yes if they want no limit on our liability, if the draft sets no limit, or if some claims have no limit, for example data protection, confidentiality or intellectual property claims. Claims for fraud, deliberate wrongdoing, death or personal injury, or for payment of the agreed price do not count. Not sure? Choose Yes and say why in “What do you need from legal?”.
uncapped_liability.error: Choose whether there is unlimited liability on our side

urgency.label: How soon do you need an answer?
urgency.error: Choose how soon you need an answer

options.blocker: Work has stopped until legal answers

description.label: What do you need from legal?
description.hint: A few sentences: what happened, what you need, and anything you are not sure about. Use made-up details only.
description.error: Describe what you need from legal

deadline.label: Date you need an answer by
deadline.hint: Year, month and day, for example 2026-12-01.
deadline.error: Enter the date you need an answer by

questions.label: Annual contract value in EUR
questions.error: Enter the annual contract value in EUR

questions.label: Target signature date
questions.hint: Year, month and day, for example 2026-12-15.
questions.error: Enter the target signature date

questions.label: Changes the other party asked for
questions.hint: For example longer payment terms or a higher limit on liability. Write none if there are none. If you do not know, write not sure.
questions.error: Enter the changes the other party asked for, or write none or not sure

questions.label: Business owner on your side
questions.hint: The person in your company who is responsible for this contract.
questions.error: Enter the business owner on your side

What will the supplier provide?

questions.hint: If you do not know, write not sure.

questions.label: Has IT security reviewed the supplier?
questions.hint: Not sure? Choose No and say why in “What do you need from legal?”.
questions.error: Choose whether IT security has reviewed the supplier

questions.label: Who decides what the data is used for?
questions.hint: This is not about whose software or systems handle it. If the other party will also use the data for its own purposes, for example to improve its products, or you are not sure, say so in “What do you need from legal?”.
options: The other party decides (we are the processor)
We decide together (we are joint controllers)

questions.error: Enter what the data is used for

questions.label: Which countries outside the EEA?
questions.hint: Include the countries where the data is or will be held and where anyone who gets or sees it is based. If you do not know, write not sure.
questions.error: Enter the countries outside the EEA, or write not sure

questions.label: Will sub-processors be involved?
questions.hint: A sub-processor is another company or contractor that the processor uses to handle some of the data, such as a hosting or support provider, or a company in the processor's own group. Not sure? Choose Yes and say why in “What do you need from legal?”.
questions.error: Choose whether sub-processors will be involved

questions.label: Whose personal data is it about?
questions.hint: For example customers, employees or job applicants.
questions.error: Enter whose personal data it is about

questions.label: Has a person asked about their own data?
questions.hint: For example they asked what data you hold about them, for a copy, to correct or delete it, to move it to another company, to stop using it, or for someone to review a decision made by a computer. They might not use legal words. Not sure? Choose Yes and say why in “What do you need from legal?”.
questions.error: Choose whether a person has asked about their own data

questions.label: When did their request arrive?
questions.hint: The first date it reached our company or anyone acting for us, for example a shared inbox, a colleague or a supplier, even if that was before it reached you. Year, month and day, for example 2026-11-02. Not sure? Give the earliest likely date and say why in “What do you need from legal?”.

questions.hint: For example hiring, managing staff, education, credit, insurance or access to a service. Not sure? Choose Yes and say why in “What do you need from legal?”.
questions.error: Choose whether its output will affect decisions about people

questions.label: Does a person check each output before it is used?
questions.hint: Choose Yes only if that person understands the output, can change or overrule it, and does so when it looks wrong. Not sure, or only some outputs are checked? Choose No and say why in “What do you need from legal?”.
